events.title: Alpha.30: final characters, rebuilt jump physics, and the ruins
events.summary: Six characters in the gameSince the original Don't Step Wrong, the game always ran with a single character. Alpha.30 brings all 6 characters with their final models and animations. Each one required individual calibration of physics, size and movement. Along the way, a number of cosmetic animation issues that had been piling up got fixed.Jump physics rebuiltThe jump mechanic was completely rewritten. events.title: Alpha.29: Sandy Desert, Fireflies and Atmosphere
events.summary: Sandy Desert Gets 10 New StagesThe Sandy Desert zone just grew significantly. The team shipped 10 new stages this week, continuing to build out one of the game's most visually distinct areas.FirefliesThis one was genuinely fun to make. Fireflies have no role in gameplay at all. They just fly around. But we wanted the environments to feel alive, and static scenes only go so far.Each firefly is a small object with a pulsing light. events.title: Devlog Alpha .28: 10 New Stages, Overhauled Loot System, and Marsh Progress
events.summary: 10 New Stages in the RuinsBuild alpha.28 is live, expanding the game world with 10 brand-new stages in the Ruins zone. These stages bring fresh logic challenges and layouts designed to push your deductive skills even further.A New Way to Earn RewardsWe have completely overhauled how rewards work. We moved away from the fixed reward of 10 blocks when clearing a stage for the first time. Now, a dynamic loot system takes its place, rolling a reward between 5 and 20 coins. events.title: The demo is out!
events.summary: The demo is out. Six stages, free to play.Each stage in Don't Step Wrong has one rule. You step on blocks, something happens, and you start to figure it out. Some rules take less time than others.There are no hints by default. Just the grid and whatever you can work out from what you see.If you've been following the development, thanks for sticking around. If you're new here, the demo is a good place to start.Hope you like it!
